Use case: precise-object-edit. Deliver pale-recover-1.png, one square 1024x1024 transparent PNG.
Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 shows the original pot and pale old leaves.
Make ONLY the SIX new GREEN leaves in Image 1 much SMALLER: reduce their length and width to one quarter of their current dimensions, tiny fresh buds just unfolding at each of the three shoot tips, two per shoot. The pale-yellow old leaves remain large and drooping and completely unchanged. Early recovery, very modest new growth.
Keep absolutely everything else identical to Image 1, especially the exact glass pot, gold rim, dark soil and white root details, object scale, pot location, camera viewpoint, three stem heights, pale color and arrangement. Do not shorten the stretched stems. Do not remove the older yellow leaves. Maintain the reference's detailed painterly 3D material rendering. Genuine transparent background, no text.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Deliver dry-recover-1.png as one square 1024x1024 transparent PNG sprite for a children's science game.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is ONLY the leaf material and healthy color style reference, NOT the composition.
Same glass pot with gold rim and the same THREE bean seedlings as Image 1: IDENTICAL pot size and position, root patterns, framing, camera angle, and seedling arrangement, middle tallest, outer two lower.
Change ONLY to halfway recovery after watering: soil dark brown and moist, cracks softened/closed into moist clumps; the previously wilted drooping leaves lifted about halfway, stems slightly straighter, leaves a little greener and less shrivelled but still visibly partially drooping and not fully healthy. No extra seedlings, no new mature leaves, no watering can. Retain visible white roots through the glass.
Match reference's detailed soft painterly 3D illustration, clean studio lighting, centered whole object with same transparent padding as Image 1. Genuine alpha transparent background, no text.

Use case: scientific-educational. Deliver thermometer.png as one square 1024x1024 transparent PNG game prop.
The two input images are STYLE REFERENCES only. Match their softly painterly, realistic detailed 3D materials, brass accents, natural textures and clean studio lighting.
A classic glass laboratory thermometer standing upright on a small round wooden base, brass cap on top, red bulb at bottom. Critical functional constraint: the narrow GLASS CAPILLARY TUBE above the bulb is COMPLETELY EMPTY and clear, with NO colored or red liquid column inside it. Software will draw the column later. Red is confined to the bottom bulb only.
Cream backing plate behind the glass capillary, accurate printed Celsius scale 0 to 30 increasing from bottom to top. Tick every 5 degrees: 0,5,10,15,20,25,30. Print only the four numerals "0", "10", "20", "30", plus a small "°C" near the top. One subtle small green band spanning between 20 and 25 degrees. No other text.
Straight front view, perfectly vertical, tall narrow thermometer centered within square canvas, whole base and top visible, transparent padding. No seedlings or glass pot. Genuine alpha transparent background.

Replace the tiny fresh green buds with several LARGE healthy DEEP-GREEN broad open glossy leaves, three to four green leaves per shoot, clearly bigger and greener than the old pale leaves. The OLD LOWER PALE YELLOW LEAVES stay visible and unchanged. The stretched stems REMAIN LONG AND THIN and never shrink.
Keep exactly the same glass pot with gold rim, pot position and size, dark soil, white root patterns, composition, viewpoint and three seedlings' arrangement of Image 1 (left tallest, middle medium, right shortest). No changing pot proportions or moving the pot. Allow the enlarged leaves in the space surrounding the original shoot tips, keeping everything inside the canvas.
Match the detailed soft painterly 3D illustration and studio lighting of the input. Whole object visible, true transparent alpha background. No text or additional props.

Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver heat-mat.png, one square 1024x1024 transparent PNG sprite.
Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match their realistic softly painterly 3D materials, fine details and clean studio lighting.
A flat rectangular seedling heat mat used in real gardening, dark green rubber surface with a subtle grid pattern, a cable leading from one side to a small white controller box with a clear digital display showing EXACTLY "22°C" and a small orange heat icon (three rising heat waves). Subtle soft warm orange glow ONLY along the edges of the mat. Real gardening tool, not a hotplate or mattress.
Three-quarter top view, centered, wide horizontal composition within a square canvas. Entire rectangular mat, cord and controller visible with ample padding, one connected tool, no pot or plant placed on it. No other objects or text. Genuine alpha transparent background, no floor or backdrop.

Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver field-camera.png as one square 1024x1024 transparent PNG sprite.
The input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their detailed soft painterly 3D rendering, natural materials, warm brass accents, clean studio light.
A friendly vintage field camera for a young nature explorer. STRICT STRAIGHT FRONT VIEW, facing the viewer, symmetrical camera front, lens optical axis facing straight out at viewer with no camera yaw. Cream and forest-green leather body with brass trim, one large round glass lens in the center with a soft reflection, a shutter button on top, a small green leaf charm and a brown leather strap. Cute rounded proportions but sophisticated enough for elementary pupils. No words, letters, brand name or logo.
One camera, centered, whole camera and strap visible with padding, true alpha transparent background. No pot, plants, scene or extra props.

Side view, centered.

Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver photo-frame.png as one square 1024x1024 transparent PNG UI sprite.
Input images are references ONLY for soft lighting, painterly 3D material quality and natural color warmth; DO NOT include the plants or pots.
One classic instant-photo PAPER FRAME, slightly warm off-white paper with subtle fine paper texture, narrow left/right/top margins and a much thicker bottom margin, with one strip of light-green semi-opaque washi tape placed horizontally across the center of the top edge. Straight front view without tilt or perspective. Whole paper frame centered within a square canvas with modest transparent padding.
CRITICAL: the LARGE SQUARE PHOTO WINDOW in the middle is a COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT EMPTY CUTOUT, genuine alpha zero, showing nothing at all. Software will insert a photograph there later. Do not fill it with white, gray, checkers, a picture, glass or a plant. The outside of the frame is also transparent. Only the paper border and tape are visible. Very soft subtle drop shadow around the paper. No text, no logo, no extra props.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this thermometer to match the required scientific scale. Deliver one square 1024x1024 transparent PNG.
Preserve the same brass-capped thermometer, wooden round base, glass, cream backing, empty clear capillary and red bottom bulb, front-facing viewpoint, materials, and composition.
CHANGE ONLY THE PRINTED SCALE to EXACTLY SEVEN horizontal marks, evenly spaced vertically at 0,5,10,15,20,25,30 degrees Celsius. NO intermediate one-degree marks. Four longer ticks with printed labels on the left "0","10","20","30"; three short ticks at 5,15,25 with no printed number. Label 0 at bottom, 30 at top. Small "°C" at top.
Green band EXACTLY spans the interval from the 20 mark up to the 25 mark, starting at 20, not above it.
Keep the capillary above the bottom bulb EMPTY CLEAR: no red liquid column. Red only in the bottom bulb and its short neck below the zero scale point.
Entire top finial and entire base must be visible with at least 4% padding at top and bottom, no cropping. Genuine alpha transparent background. No other changes.
